title: antipattern_finding.v1
description: One normalized anti-pattern finding, as rig and the Reviewer both emit it. A detector hit (tool + the tool's rule ID + location) is looked up in antipatterns.v1 by (tool, rule_id); a hit with no catalog rule is not a finding (it is counted as unmapped). blocking is the constant false in v1: an anti-pattern finding never fails a build or starts a review round on its own.

severity.description: Copied from the catalog rule, never from the detector.

enforcement_state.description: Only advisory rules produce findings; planned and retired rules produce none.

fingerprint.description: First 16 hex chars of sha256 over rule_id|file|start_line|detector.rule_id; identical for both consumers.
